title: Embeddings & Rerank starter-flow visuals and annotated output templates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a compact, developer-facing starter flow for the Embeddings + Rerank onboarding path. Assets required: 1) a simplified pipeline diagram that explains embedding generation -> candidate retrieval -> rerank steps with latency/ cost annotations; 2) three annotated screenshot variants (web hero, mobile stepper, console mini-playground) showing sample inputs and model outputs; 3) a set of sample output cards (good / ambiguous / failure cases) with short copy for docs; 4) accessible color variants and alt text for all images; 5) a short 'how it works' micro-illustration for the quickstart banner. Focus: clarity for engineers, minimal copy for product docs, and assets that can be dropped into the docs site and marketing quickstart.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline diagram (SVG + PNG) with labeled stages, average token counts, and per-stage median latency annotations
Three responsive screenshots exported at 1x/2x with in-image annotations and separate alt text file entries
Five sample output cards (strings) covering high-confidence, partial-match, ambiguous, low-recall, and error cases
All assets included in Drive + Figma prototype with export-ready layers and a short handoff checklist
Designer review and PM approval recorded; minor design feedback addressed
sample_outputs: High confidence: "Top-3 results: (1) Redwood API design guidelines, (2) Serving runtime perf notes, (3) Batching best practices. Confidence: 92%"
Partial match: "Returned results are related to embeddings but may need query expansion. Suggest: expand 'cloud region' to 'APAC region availability'."
Ambiguous: "Multiple intent matches detected. Recommend rerunning with a clarifying filter or short prompt."
Low recall: "Few candidates found - try increasing corpus size or using semantic augmentation."
Error case: "Model variant mismatch fallback triggered — showing placeholder results and link to retry."
